text.intro:
A Global Retirement & Benefits Actuary in New York City.
Just a Malaysian that's 10,000 miles away from home chasing her "American Dream".
Still figuring out my true calling while doing the things I like - Math. Stay tune to my upcoming journey!
text.about: I'm Vivian, a Malaysian from Klang, Malaysia currently based in New York City, where I work as a Global Retirement & Benefits Actuary at Willis Towers Watson. My story brings together two places: the country I'm from and the city where I'm building my professional life.
text.what-i-do: Global Retirement and Benefits Actuarial Analyst

meetVersions.label: professional Vivian!
meetVersions.message: it was my first time bleaching my hair after keeping it long for a year and a half, I honestly do miss it! (from time to time)

meetVersions.label: college Vivian!
meetVersions.message: you must be one of my first friends out of my hometown, Klang area! those were some good times :)

meetVersions.label: high school Vivian!
meetVersions.message: those days were some crazy schedules moments, but I was so active and energetic all the time! I still refer high school as my prime years today. glad that you're part of this stage of my life!

meetVersions.label: little Vivian in elementary school!
meetVersions.message: I used to play so much of chess! hellu my childhood friend! I hope you no longer remembers this before puberty "face" of my life. it has been a long long time, hope we get to catch up soon!
